text: dsh-archive-button 是 DSH 网页端的会话归档插件，在侧边栏提供归档面板，并由主进程注册扫描、状态和执行接口。用户可以预览超过三天未活动的会话，查看待处理数量与体积，确认后将会话文件夹打包为 ZIP，并在字节数校验后删除原文件夹。面板显示归档进度、结果和释放空间；操作由用户点击触发。适合希望整理旧会话、减少活跃会话目录占用的网页端用户。运行需要 Windows PowerShell 5.1，并可通过 DSH_ROOT 指定 DSH 安装目录。

dsh-archive-button adds a DSH web sidebar panel to preview sessions inactive for over three days, then archive selected candidates as ZIP files after a byte check. The user confirms each run; the panel shows status and space freed. Requires Windows PowerShell 5.1.

dsh-archive-button 的功能「三天未活动会话预览」：点击侧边栏归档入口后可扫描会话目录，列出超过默认三天未活动的候选会话，并显示数量和总大小；扫描使用 DryRun，不执行归档。
dsh-archive-button 的功能「确认后归档会话」：面板展示候选数量和体积，用户点击“确认归档”后启动归档；脚本按工作区及月份生成 ZIP，并核对条目数和字节总数后移除源文件夹。
dsh-archive-button 的功能「查看运行状态与结果」：侧边栏面板从状态接口读取运行中标记、扫描结果和最近归档结果，可显示已归档数量、失败数及释放空间。
dsh-archive-button 仅在 Windows PowerShell 路径可用时运行归档脚本；归档会写入 ZIP 和状态日志，并在校验后删除原会话目录。DSH_ROOT 可用于指定归档及日志所在的 DSH 根目录。

dsh-archive-button README · dsh-archive-button：An archive button on the sidebar's workspace-title row (it falls back to an inline footer capsule when that row is not mounted). The first click dry-runs a scan and lists the sessions idle for more than 3 days; the second click packs each one into a byte-verified zip and deletes the original folder. The host half registers the `/dsh-archive/*` routes and runs the archive script; the client half only draws the button. The model never triggers it.

dsh-archive-button README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add file:<this repo>
```

Restart the web instance afterwards.

dsh-archive-button README · Environment：| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `DSH_ROOT` | `~/DeepSeek_harness` | DSH install root; the archive directory and button log are derived from it |

dsh-archive-button README · Requirements：- Windows PowerShell 5.1
- Seat: `vk.sidebar.footer` (dsh-vk-suite required)
- The archive script ships with this repo (`scripts/archive-dsh-sessions.ps1`) and works as installed
- The bundled script wins; `<DSH_ROOT>\scripts\archive-dsh-sessions.ps1` is the fallback
- A session folder is deleted only after its zip is reopened and byte-verified
